{{Quote|The general is demanding a status report. Is the hyperdrive repaired yet?|The OOM command droid.|<ref name="dm">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
This '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' was stationed on board the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]], serving under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], commander of the massive [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. In the ensuing battle, they were on the bridge of the warship to ascertain the status of the repairs to the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Moment's later, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the bridge and proceeded to destroy the OOM commander and the other battle droids stationed there.
